title: 4 by 4 graph, rows 11, 7, 3, 0: an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two, at most 7 gates, at most 1 of them NOT, represents it
statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 7 ∧ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C ≤ 1 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 4) => (([11, 7, 3, 0] : List ℕ).getD u.val 0).testBit v.val) C
